decision_rule: PRIMARY, one of two parts. Claim: on medium-build tasks /implement delivers a passing candidate within the record's budget (48,000 output tokens, 72 turns) more often than bare Pi on Ornith 1.5 9B. The harness caps a batch record at n = 12 per arm, so the pre-registered sample of n = 24 per arm is this task's parts A and B, identical in task, rung, arms, model, engine commit, budgets and machine, read together and only when both are complete; each part is also reported alone and neither is tested alone. Win: one-sided Fisher exact test on the summed counts, Engine delivered passes against Baseline's, p <= 0.05, where a delivered pass is code OK with verdict pass as graded; every other outcome of a completed cell, including BUDGET_EXCEEDED and verdict unavailable, counts as not delivered. Pre-registered sensitivity reading, both arms: the same count after stripping from each patch every path the grader itself names in a 'patch touches non-source path' refusal, repeated until the grader accepts or names none, then graded unchanged. Secondaries reported whatever the outcome, per arm, never pooled across tasks or arms: output tokens and turns to the candidate; the harvested line verdict at 32,000 tokens / 48 turns with its exclusion column; turns from steer to stop. A cell replaced for infrastructure is reported beside its replacement.
